GUN is a serious attempt at a distributed/p2p database. It's never going to get you transactions/acid compliance because that just doesn't work well in a distributed environment. If you try to do that in a distributed environment you end up with something like a blockchain where you can only agree on the state of the world every 5-10 minutes or so.

GUN is eventually consistent, you wouldn't want to build a financial system on it; but the fact that one notabug peer can be an unrestricted bastion of free speech while another filters out "racism" and another filters out "degeneracy" is a feature, not a bug.

Since the peers aren't forced to agree on/maintain all the data they can maintain maximum flexibility wrt site policy. My goal is to eventually get normies, nazis and sjw's all conversing in the same content network without any of them feeling like they are materially supporting those they disagree with, or being forced to encounter content they find objectionable.
